provisions.label: Limit or sunset E-Rate
provisions.policy_option: Reduce, sunset or terminate ongoing E-Rate support because the connectivity mission is fulfilled.

provisions.label: Narrow eligible equipment and services
provisions.policy_option: Limit support for categories currently eligible, including internal connections, or preserve eligibility despite calls for narrowing.

provisions.label: Restrict special construction or dark fiber
provisions.policy_option: Restrict, eliminate, or preserve E-Rate support for special construction, self-provisioned networks or dark fiber.

provisions.label: Change poverty and rural discount matrix
provisions.policy_option: Change the NSLP- and urban/rural-based discount calculation or preserve current discount rates.

provisions.label: Limit subsidies by broadband competition
provisions.policy_option: Target E-Rate to high-cost, rural, or single-provider areas, or retain support regardless of competition.

provisions.label: Address vendor influence and procurement incentives
provisions.policy_option: Impose or reject safeguards addressing the role of vendors in technology selection and procurement.

provisions.label: Tie E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes
provisions.policy_option: Use measured student or educational outcomes to condition or evaluate E-Rate funding.

provisions.label: Condition E-Rate on screen-time limits
provisions.policy_option: Require schools or libraries to impose screen-time limits as a condition of E-Rate funding.

provisions.label: Parent opt-out from screen-based instruction
provisions.policy_option: Condition E-Rate funding on schools offering a meaningful parent opt-out from screen-based instruction.

provisions.label: Supervision and reporting unsafe content
provisions.policy_option: Require supervision or mechanisms to report inappropriate content on E-Rate-funded networks.

provisions.label: Restrict Pre-K and Head Start support
provisions.policy_option: Remove or limit E-Rate eligibility or require cost allocation for Pre-K or Head Start students and facilities.

provisions.label: Extend CIPA to third-party-owned devices
provisions.policy_option: Apply CIPA protections to personally owned devices connecting to E-Rate-supported networks.

provisions.label: Require network-level content filtering
provisions.policy_option: Mandate filtering at the network level, not solely school/library-owned computers.

provisions.label: Interpret monitoring requirements and privacy
provisions.policy_option: Clarify or modify CIPA monitoring of minors' online activity with attention to privacy.

provisions.label: Change CIPA treatment of social media
provisions.policy_option: Reverse or retain the interpretation that social-networking sites are not per se harmful to minors.

provisions.label: Require digital/media literacy courses
provisions.policy_option: Require completion of digital/media literacy or internet-safety training tied to E-Rate-supported access.

provisions.label: Age-specific internet protections
provisions.policy_option: Use differing online protections or screen restrictions for younger versus older children.

provisions.label: Publish internet safety policies
provisions.policy_option: Require public disclosure, stronger standards, retention or oversight of school/library CIPA policies.

provisions.label: Strengthen hearings and CIPA enforcement
provisions.policy_option: Require more timely or repeated public notices/hearings and/or stronger funding consequences for CIPA violations.

provisions.label: FCC-imposed daily hour limits
provisions.policy_option: Impose per-day limits on children's use of E-Rate-funded networks or services.

provisions.label: Define covered E-Rate consultants
provisions.policy_option: Adopt or amend the proposed definition of non-employee consultants, potentially including or excluding resellers/channel partners.

provisions.label: Annual consultant certification and disclosure
provisions.policy_option: Require annual consultant certifications and conflicts-of-interest disclosures through proposed FCC Form 5654.

provisions.label: Individual consultant registration database
provisions.policy_option: Create individual consultant registration/number requirements for monitoring E-Rate participation.

provisions.label: Prohibit percentage-based consultant fees
provisions.policy_option: Prohibit consultant fees tied to a percentage of contract or E-Rate funding amounts.

provisions.label: Consultant document-retention requirements
provisions.policy_option: Clarify or strengthen records that applicants/providers must retain concerning consultant arrangements.

provisions.label: Streamline and certify E-Rate forms
provisions.policy_option: Change administrative deadlines, filings, contract timing, certifications or procurement compliance.

provisions.label: Managed internal broadband service eligibility
provisions.policy_option: Change eligibility or reseller requirements for managed internal broadband services (MIBS).

provisions.label: Lowest corresponding price protections
provisions.policy_option: Reconsider enforcement, transparency or obligations for lowest corresponding price requirements.

provisions.label: Delete obsolete Emergency Connectivity Fund regulations
provisions.policy_option: Remove completed Emergency Connectivity Fund rules from the Code of Federal Regulations.
